headline: 80% of Claude Code's system prompt removed for advanced Claude 5 models, new context rules emerge
summary: Anthropic has drastically reduced system prompts for advanced Claude 5 models, leading to new context engineering strategies. Developers can apply these lessons to their own agents and Claude Code.
details: Anthropic has significantly reduced the system prompt for its Claude Code models, removing over 80% of the original context. This change is specifically for advanced Claude 5 generation models, signaling a shift in how developers interact with the AI.

The reduction in prompt size necessitates new rules for context engineering. These updated guidelines are crucial for optimizing performance and ensuring effective communication with the more advanced Claude models.

Developers can leverage the lessons learned from this prompt optimization to refine their own context engineering practices. This applies not only to working with Claude Code but also to designing and managing their custom AI agents.
